name: Aimed Shot
description: A carefully aimed shot that deals heavy damage.

name: Arcane Shot
description: Fire an arrow infused with arcane energy.

name: Multi-Shot
description: Fire arrows at multiple enemies simultaneously.

name: Explosive Trap
description: Place a trap that explodes when triggered.

name: Freezing Trap
description: Place a trap that freezes enemies.

name: Call Pet
description: Summon your animal companion to fight alongside you.

name: Mend Pet
description: Heal your pet over time.

name: Bestial Wrath
description: Your pet enters a rage, dealing increased damage.

name: Kill Command
description: Command your pet to savagely attack.

name: Disengage
description: Leap backwards away from danger.

name: Feign Death
description: Play dead to escape combat.

name: Camouflage
description: Blend into surroundings, becoming harder to detect.

name: Barrage
description: Rapidly fire at all enemies in a cone.

name: Black Arrow
description: Fire a shadow-infused arrow that deals damage over time.

name: Counter Shot
description: Interrupt an enemy spellcast.

name: Snake Trap
description: Release venomous snakes that attack enemies.

name: Aspect of the Cheetah
description: Take on cheetah aspects for increased speed.

name: Rapid Fire
description: Fire a quick burst of shots at high speed.

name: Stampede
description: Summon all your pets to attack together.

name: Masters Call
description: Your pet frees you from movement impairment.
